decisions.reason: Because it builds directly on existing aloe vera and facial-care knowledge and has kept its own page, the firm can interpret its results as positive and continue improving it.
Although only mentioned on the website, it is close to established serum and skincare know-how, and two years of market presence let the firm assimilate results and refine it.
As a recent launch close to existing cleansing and oil knowledge, the firm can apply its absorptive capacity, but shorter market evidence gives it a moderately higher drop risk.
